Solar Irrigation in Africa: Financing Farm Returns Within Water Limits

Solar irrigation can make water cheaper to lift without making it more abundant, or crops more valuable. Recent African programmes are shifting attention from equipment access to the institutions around it. This paper examines how public and private capital can finance durable farm returns while respecting water limits, and why pump sales, loan repayment and sustainable agricultural development must be measured separately.
